description: Explicit capability declarations for renderer routing and analytical tools.

can_collocate_with_profiles.description: Dataset supports automated 4D spatiotemporal collocation with in-situ profiles.
can_collocate_with_profiles.title: Can Collocate With Profiles

can_exact_query.description: Dataset supports exact quantitative cell inspection from canonical arrays.
can_exact_query.title: Can Exact Query

can_extract_isosurface.description: Dataset supports 3D Marching Cubes / GPU isosurface polygonization.
can_extract_isosurface.title: Can Extract Isosurface

can_horizontal_slice.description: Dataset supports arbitrary horizontal depth plane slicing.
can_horizontal_slice.title: Can Horizontal Slice

can_render_bathymetry_terrain.description: Dataset contains digital bathymetry elevation eligible for 3D seafloor mesh clipping.
can_render_bathymetry_terrain.title: Can Render Bathymetry Terrain

can_render_observation_profiles.description: Dataset contains in-situ 1D vertical profile casts (Argo, CTD).
can_render_observation_profiles.title: Can Render Observation Profiles

can_render_observation_trajectories.description: Dataset contains 4D moving observation paths (Glider yo-yo dives, drifters).
can_render_observation_trajectories.title: Can Render Observation Trajectories

can_render_streamlines.description: Dataset supports streamline or particle flow integration.
can_render_streamlines.title: Can Render Streamlines

can_render_vector_glyphs.description: Dataset contains vector components (u, v, w) eligible for 2D/3D arrow glyph rendering.
can_render_vector_glyphs.title: Can Render Vector Glyphs

can_surface_render_2d.description: Dataset contains 2D surface raster eligible for georeferenced surface mapping.
can_surface_render_2d.title: Can Surface Render 2D

can_vertical_slice.description: Dataset supports arbitrary vertical transect slicing.
can_vertical_slice.title: Can Vertical Slice

can_volume_render_3d.description: Dataset contains 3D/4D depth-resolved scalar field eligible for volume raymarching.
can_volume_render_3d.title: Can Volume Render 3D
